label: Вскоре
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вскоре (soon, shortly after).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shortly after. 'Вскоре' means soon or shortly afterward, modifying 'начался'. It is more bookish than 'скоро' and usually refers to a point soon after another event.
Strategic focus: Soon after an event. 'Вскоре после ужина' anchors the timing relative to dinner, modifying 'ушли'. The construction shows a short interval between two events.
Strategic focus: A quick development. 'Вскоре' marks a change that came soon afterward, modifying 'стал'. It lends a narrative, literary tone to the sentence.
Strategic focus: Near future. 'Вскоре' can point to the soon-to-come future, modifying 'прибудет'. Here it signals that the train will arrive shortly.
Strategic focus: Soon afterward. 'Вскоре' frames the wedding as following soon after an earlier point, modifying 'поженились'. It is a common storytelling connector.

missions.phrase: Тучи рассеялись, и вскоре выглянуло солнце.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shortly after a change. 'Вскоре' links a second event closely to the first, modifying 'выглянуло'. It conveys that the sun appeared soon after the clouds cleared.
Strategic focus: Soon to come. 'Вскоре' projects a near future, modifying 'забудется'. It expresses calm certainty that the matter will soon be forgotten.
Strategic focus: Soon after a trigger. 'Вскоре после звонка' fixes the timing right after the call, modifying 'приехал'. It marks a short gap between cause and arrival.
Strategic focus: Resolved soon. 'Вскоре' marks the illness passing not long after, modifying 'прошла'. The register is slightly elevated and narrative.
Strategic focus: Coming soon. 'Вскоре' points to the imminent future, modifying 'узнаем'. It tells the listener the results will be known shortly.
